payload.description_html: Map of Cretaceous fossil localities bearing Notosuchian remains or remains similar to notosuchians. 1) isolated tooth from the Alsópere Bauxite (Hungary), Albian; 2) Hamadasuchus-like teeth from Charentes (France), Cenomanian; 3)  isolated tooth from Polazzo (Italy), Coniacian–Santonian; 4) Doratodon carcharidens, Iharkut Biota (Hungary), Santonian; 5) Doratodon carcharidens, type locality, Muthmannsdorf (Austria), Early Campanian; 6) Doratodon cf. carcharidens, Villaggio del Pescatore (Italy), Early–Middle Campanian; 7)  cf. Doratodon, Kozina (Slovenia), Campanian?; 8) Doratodon ibericus, Chera (Spain), Middle–Late Campanian; 9) cf. Doratodon isolated teeth, Tremp Formation (Spain), Maastrichtian, 10) Ogresuchus furatus, Tremp Formation (Spain), Maastrichtian; 11) Doratodon sp. isolated teeth, Rusca Montană Basin (Romania), Maastrichtian; 12) Doratodon sp. and Ziphosuchia indet. isolated teeth, Hateg Basin (Romania), Maastrichtian; 13) cf. Doratodon dentary fragment, Sebeş (Romania), Maastrichtian
